### Summary

Building AI to empower knowledge workers in high-judgment domains like law, finance and consulting.

### Experience

**Microsoft** — Applied Scientist II, 2026–present
- Designed AI evaluations and experimentation systems for Copilot in Office
- Consulted on strategic initiatives for translation of AI science into product
- Served as lead scientist on a project for VP of Eng with legal/accessibility considerations & trained 4 testers

**Stanford Law School** — AI Engineering Fellow, 2025–2026
- Led 9-person team from Stanford, Harvey, Snorkel AI with 50 lawyers to develop a judgment benchmark
- Gave talks about quality in legal AI at Cambridge Business School and Snorkel AI Frontier Data Summit
- Built a product prototype for spinout and drove demos to Biglaw partners and VC partners

**Independent Consultant** — Contract Scientist & Science Writer, 2022–2023
- Recent engagement: ~1000 billed hours over 1.5 years to a test prep firm developing mock MCATs

- Citadel, Trading Intern, 2024
- KKR, Summer Analyst, 2023
- Johnson & Johnson, Robotics Data Science Co-op, 2022
- Stanford University School of Medicine, Research Intern then Data Analyst, 2019–2020
